## Volume leveling for individual clips

- Analyze a selected clip and review a proposed loudness adjustment before applying it.
- Limit volume boosts using measured peak headroom, without automatic compression.
- Accept or reject the proposal, undo the adjustment, or remove leveling from a clip.
- Save leveling adjustments in editing projects and use the same adjustment in preview and export.

Leveling applies to individual clips. It does not guarantee the final peak level of overlapping tracks or lossy exports.

## Windows download

Download and extract `MokaMusic-v3.0.1-windows.zip`, then run `MokaMusic.exe` inside the extracted folder. Keep the complete folder together. Audio processing requires FFmpeg to be installed and available on PATH.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/AndrewMtz23/Moka-Music/compare/v3.0.0...v3.0.1
